protocol.development_basis: The full local-refinement differential proposal detects all wider reference-positive probes, with one CFO mismatch. Native local correlation dominates proposal cost. Test ranking centers first and refining only the retained neighborhood.
protocol.scope: Staged native differential proposals with unchanged original-IQ fractional confirmation
algorithm_changes: Rank the eight native-rate proposal-center scores, then evaluate the two neighboring native cells only for the retained proposal. This may change candidate ranking and must be separately quality-tested.
